notes.title: Deep Night Detective - Chapter One CONTROL PATCH!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311732/f5586dcb01b4d5e345e8876656af42b798a4c902.png[/img]

Hey! We've- okay, I've heard the cries of the people! And while yes most people's cries aren't DIRECTLY related to Deep Night Detective, I thought I'd give the people what they wanted anyway!

An improved Options menu, available straight on the game's main menu, overhauled keyboard controls and an actual keymapper!

Is Chapter 2 on the way? Yes! It is! Will it be here soon? No! Not at all! But I'm working on it, just you wait!

Thanks for playing, please comment or hit me up on the twitter at @DeepNightDet if you find bugs, I am paying attention, and thank you guys so much for playing!

-Wilson T.
